edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender of the public transfer call.
msg.sender determines whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the owner granting the allowance in approve.
msg.sender is the mint recipient in the SimpleERC20 constructor.
The SimpleERC20 constructor invokes _mint for the initial supply.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded as the ServicePayer receiver address.
receiver is cast to IPayable inside the ServicePayer constructor.
serviceName is used as constructor argument for the payment service.
serviceName is passed directly into the external pay call.
The ServicePayer constructor executes the external pay call during construction.
The external pay call hands control to an untrusted receiver that may reenter.
sender parameter is consumed by _transfer balance logic.
recipient parameter is consumed by _transfer balance logic.
amount parameter drives the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
_balances[sender] is read into the senderBalance local variable.
senderBalance is subtracted by amount to produce the new balance.
_transfer performs the debiting subtraction operation.
The subtracted result is written back into the _balances mapping.
amount is added to the recipient balance.
_transfer performs the crediting addition operation.
The credited amount is written into the _balances mapping.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom first performs the token movement via _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance via _approve.
_allowances[sender][caller] is read into currentAllowance.
currentAllowance - amount is the reduced allowance written by _approve.
approve calls the internal _approve setter.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the summed allowance.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance.
_approve writes the new value into the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf reads the account balance from the _balances mapping.
_mint adds the minted amount to _totalSupply.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from _totalSupply.
_burn reads and clears the account balance held in _balances.
name_ is supplied to the SimpleERC20 constructor call chain.
symbol_ is supplied to the SimpleERC20 constructor call chain.
initialBalance_ is validated and minted by the constructor.
initialBalance_ becomes the minted amount added to total supply.
sender argument selects whose tokens transferFrom moves.
recipient argument receives the transferred tokens.
amount argument bounds the allowance consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender's existing allowance is read and increased.
msg.sender's existing allowance is read and decreased.
spender parameter is the address granted the allowance in approve.
amount parameter is the allowance value set in approve.
spender is written into the _allowances mapping by _approve.
name_ is stored into the _name state variable.
symbol_ is stored into the _symbol state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor argument only used to initialize token metadata for the deployment.
symbol_ is a constructor argument only used to initialize token metadata for the deployment.
initialBalance_ is a constructor argument validated and minted once at deployment.
feeReceiver_ is a deployment argument forwarded to the ServicePayer payment constructor.
receiver is a deployment argument that becomes the IPayable target of the payment call.
serviceName is passed verbatim into the external payable call and has no other role.
sender is a transient transfer argument consumed by the _transfer balance logic.
recipient is a transient transfer argument consumed by the _transfer balance logic.
amount is a transient transfer argument consumed by the _transfer arithmetic.
senderBalance is a cached value that exists only to compute the _balances debit.
currentAllowance is a cached allowance value local to the transferFrom allowance reduction.
spender is an approval argument routed into the _approve allowance writer.
amount is an approval argument routed into the _approve allowance writer.
